videos.title: How Attention Actually Works: Math, GPU Memory, and Systems
videos.description:
A complete, first-principles breakdown of the Attention mechanism from "Attention Is All You Need"—moving past surface-level intuition down to the linear algebra, GPU execution, and real production bottlenecks.

In this deep dive, we trace:
• Why recurrent architectures failed at scale (and how parallel matrix ops fixed it)
• Tokenization, dense vector embeddings, and sinusoidal positional encodings
• Query, Key, and Value: decoupling search intent from content payloads
• The "Softmax Killer": variance scaling and gradient preservation
• Single-Head limitations vs. Multi-Head parallel subspaces
• Causal masking mechanics for autoregressive token generation
• Production systems limits: O(N²) quadratic scaling, memory bandwidth bounds, and KV Cache bloat
